component.name: Markdown Reader
component.summary: Read, edit and preview Markdown files

description.p: Markdown Reader opens Markdown files as clean, readable pages and lets you edit them side by side with a live preview.

ul.li: GitHub-flavoured Markdown: tables, task lists, footnotes, alerts
Math with KaTeX and diagrams with Mermaid
Side-by-side editing with scroll sync, and search
Local images, links between documents, and a table of contents
Print, and export to PDF or a self-contained HTML page
Follows changes made to the file by other programs
